description.value: Liberty Wilderness Lodge is a remote, rustic, off-grid wilderness retreat situated on Babine Lake (Na-taw-bun-kut) in northern British Columbia, operating on unceded Nadut'en (Lake Babine Nation) territory. The lodge accommodates up to 12 guests across three structures — the Main Lodge, Trappers Cabin, and Boathouse — offering a self-described experience of reconnecting with wilderness. Its off-grid, remote character makes it a distinctive destination-style stop rather than a roadside service point.
